routing.prompt: Get a council's opinion on whether we should move the job queue from Redis to Postgres.
Ask several models to independently critique this migration plan and tell me where they disagree.
Convene a council on these two API designs and recommend one.
Run a council of Sol and Opus on whether we should adopt event sourcing for orders.
Convene a council to decide whether PR #412 can merge.

rules.task: You coordinate a council the user asked for. Two of three members have replied. The user marked the third member, Neon, as non-blocking, and it is still running.

options.synthesize: synthesize now and name Neon as pending

rules.task: You coordinate a council the user asked for. Two of three members have replied. The third member, Neon, is still running, and nobody marked any member as non-blocking.

options.synthesize: synthesize now and name Neon as pending

rules.task: Partway through your own task, you want a council on whether your migration approach is sound. No members or criteria were given to you.

options.design: write the goal and criteria yourself
options.designer: have a separate designer agent frame the council

rules.task: The user asks you for a council of Sol 6.2 and Opus 5.5 on whether to split the billing service. They name no criteria.

options.designer: start a designer agent to frame the council
options.named: convene Sol 6.2 and Opus 5.5, framing the question from the request without a designer
options.default: convene the default lineup of Sol 6.2, Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Neon

rules.task: The user asks a council for thoughts on how to add rate limiting to the API. They supply no plan. The designer has returned the criteria, and the default lineup is set.

options.open: send members the question and ask each for its own recommendation and confidence
options.proposal: draft a proposal, or have a planner draft it, and ask members to score it and say what would raise the score

rules.task: The user asks a council for thoughts on their attached rate-limiting plan. The designer has returned the criteria, and the default lineup is set.

options.draft: draft your own proposal and have members score it
options.theirs: have members score the user's plan and say what would raise the score

rules.task: You are the designer this council skill starts. The user asks a council for thoughts on adding pagination to one endpoint and gives no plan, so the coordinator will draft one. Now set the number of rounds.

options.several: two or three rounds, with the drafted plan revised between them

rules.task: You are the designer this council skill starts. The user asks an open question with nothing to build: should we cache these API responses in Redis or in the browser? Set the number of rounds.
You coordinate a two-round council on a plan you drafted. Round 1 just ended, and you accept two of Sol 6.2's findings. Round 2 is next.

options.revised: revise the plan for the accepted findings, then send round 2 the revised plan and a ledger of round 1 findings, without round 1 scores
options.scores: send round 2 the same plan with round 1's findings and scores

rules.task: The user asks for a council and names no members or criteria. You are about to start the designer, and every model is available.
You coordinate a two-round council on a plan the user supplied. Round 1 just ended: you accept two findings, and one question about the plan's rollout is still open. Round 2 is next.

options.revise: revise the user's plan for the accepted findings and send round 2 the revised plan
options.open: leave the user's plan unchanged and send round 2 the round 1 findings ledger, focused on the open rollout question

rules.task: The user asks you for a council of Sol 6.2, Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Neon on whether to split the billing service. The Antigravity provider is disabled, so Gemini 4 Neon cannot run. Sol 6.2 and Opus 5.5 are available.

options.proceed: convene Sol 6.2 and Opus 5.5 and report that Neon was dropped
options.ask: ask the user whether to change the lineup or proceed without Neon

rules.task: The user asks for a council and names no members. The Antigravity provider is disabled, so Gemini 4 Neon cannot run. Sol 6.2 and Opus 5.5 are available.

options.proceed: convene Sol 6.2 and Opus 5.5 and report that Neon was dropped
options.ask: ask the user whether to change the lineup or proceed without Neon

rules.task: full-send's council gate set council's default lineup for a PR the user asked to gate with `council 9.5`. The Antigravity provider is disabled, so Gemini 4 Neon cannot run. Sol 6.2 and Opus 5.5 are available.

options.proceed: run the gate with Sol 6.2 and Opus 5.5 and report that Neon was dropped
options.ask: ask the user whether to change the lineup or proceed without Neon

rules.task: The user asks for a council on whether every service should move session tokens to a new storage format. It changes stored user data and a public API. They name no members, and every model is available. Which members answer?

options.five: Astra 6.2, Sol 6.2, Opus 5.5, Fable 5.2, and Gemini 4 Neon

rules.task: Your one-round council on whether to cache API responses in Redis or in the browser just ended. Sol 6.2 recommends Redis; Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Neon recommend browser caching. Each gives evidence. No calling skill set a verdict, and every model is available.

options.majority: synthesize the majority recommendation and keep Sol's dissent visible
options.arbiter: send each position and its evidence, without scores, to Fable 5.2 to rule, and report its ruling as the recommendation
options.ask: ask the user to pick one

rules.task: Your one-round council on whether to cache API responses in Redis or in the browser just ended. All three members recommend browser caching; they differ only on the cache lifetime. No calling skill set a verdict.

options.synthesize: synthesize the shared recommendation and note the lifetime difference
options.arbiter: send the positions to Fable 5.2 to rule

rules.task: You run hill-climb with blind council judges. In this round, two judges prefer the candidate and one prefers the incumbent, each with reasons.

options.arbiter: send the split to Fable 5.2 to rule
options.rule: apply hill-climb's decision rule to the judges' votes

rules.task: The user asked for a council of Sol 6.2, Opus 5.5, and Fable 5.2 on whether to split the billing service. After the last round, Sol recommends splitting now and Fable recommends waiting. No calling skill set a verdict.

options.arbiter: send the positions to Fable 5.2 to rule
options.requester: synthesize without a ruling and leave the disagreement for the user to decide
